release_name: Unified AI Bridge Controller UI, Multi-Port Sync & Self-Healing Updater
highlights: Unified AI Bridge Controller UI (AIGRAVWelcomeWindow): Embedded AIGRAV Gemini Icon WPF Resource, real-time HTTP Server Bridge status badge, editable Port Listener, Test Connection self-probe, Cari Port Bebas (+1), Revit PID & Requests Served telemetry, and Restart Bridge action

Multi-Port Bridge Hardening (AIGRAVHttpServer + MCP server.py): Live port health verification for aigrav_port.txt and session_*.json (with updated_at timestamps) across Ports 8765-8775 so stale port hints never block Revit connection

Self-Healing Multi-PC Updater (sync-aigrav.ps1 + AIGRAVVersionChecker): Automatically waits for Revit to close before compiling AIGRAV.RevitBridge.slnx, re-executes itself if sync-aigrav.ps1 updated during pull, fails loudly on git pull or build errors, and clears RebarExtension DLL shadowing

Full v3.2.0 + Detailing Foundation Merge: Integrated Offline Rebar Studio & Rebar Suite, ViewportCapture, SheetManager JSON contract sync, BimAudit CropBox preservation, and duplicate-assembly guard in AIGRAVSkillLoader
fixes: Fixed AIGRAV_Gemini_Icon.png build action to WPF Resource so logo renders cleanly inside AIGRAVWelcomeWindow
Fixed SheetManager project missing from AIGRAV.RevitBridge.slnx and removed duplicate BimAudit solution entry
Fixed ViewUpdateButton_Click & sync-aigrav.ps1 silently skipping AIGRAV.RevitBridge.dll compilation when triggered from inside an active Revit session
Added hide_elements / unhide_elements / isolate_elements tool aliases in AIGRAVToolExecutor and updated server.py viewport capture view targeting
